author: 756jacquied

title: Fantastic, informative and fun!
text: Marianna was great, making sure we were all very confident before setting off, and taking us to parts of Barcelona we’d have never explored ourselves, a fantastic stop for drinks and tapas, and she was so knowledgeable about the area she took us to. She also followed up with more recommendations, and lovely messages. Thank you so much, we had a great time!
author: 401carrieg

title: Barcelona Bike Tour - Essential!!
text: We had Ale as our tour guide, she was so lovely and knowledgeable and took the time to answer all our questions during the tour. She gave us some great recommendations, tips and was fantastic. The cycling was relaxed and easy and a great way to see so many different parts of the city in just 4 hours. The tour flew by and I couldn't believe we were already back where we started. I would recommend this to anyone for a great introduction to the city.
author: oliviahH4170SO

title: Best way to see and learn about Gaudi by bike
text: Brilliant tour of Gaudi by bike with Ale in Barcelona. Could not have been more fun and Ale is exuberant, knowledgeable and fun! Super flexible to do what we wanted- and shared brilliant facts about the development of Barcelona, the olympics, the rivalry between the three major Catalan architects- Gaudi Luis Domenech i Montaner and Josep Puig I Cadafalch- the pedestrianisation of downtown Barcelona etc. I especially loved the story about the heated seats on the Passage de Garcia where wealthy residents walking in the winter could sit on the stone bases of the iron street lamps (bancos-farola).
author: KateB580

title: Great Barcelona Bike Tour
text:
The best way to see a lot of Barcelona in just couple of hours is on bike. We had a tour with emphasis on Gaudi, by we saw so much more. 
Our guide was Elisa and she was great; excellent story teller mixing historical facts with fun facts. We loved it!
author: ivangY9214FQ

title: E-Bike highlights tour — Great way to see the highlights!!
text:
Agustin was an awesome tour guide.   Riding through the streets was a blast.  Seeing landmarks and architecture.  Agustin explained everything so well.  

We rode up Montjuic to the Olympic Park and to Montjuic Castle.   

Then we headed back down to the city and Barceloneta area along the beach, which was an amazing ride.

The E-bike made the ride so easy… even going up Montjuic.
author: rjuggle

title: Great fun with Alejandra!
text: We really enjoyed the tour. Alejandra was very friendly, chatty and insightful. A great way to see the city. Barcelona is built for bikes. Would highly reccomend to anyone.
author: 33stephenc

title: Family friendly bike tour
text:
Great bike tour with our wonderful guide Bella. We are a family of 4, 2adults and children aged 12 and 9. The route was ideal with very little riding on the road, Bella was always waiting and ensuring that we were following her lead.
Bella had fantastic knowledge of Barcelona and talked us through the history of this beautiful city. Highly recommended bike tour. Gracias Bella.
author: L7924EDpaulc

title: Awesome Views and Locations with an Exceptional Guide!
text:
Our tour was absolutely amazing thanks to our guide Julio! Our first stop was La Sagrada Familia which we had toured a couple of years ago but it is always great to see again. Julio is an excellent guide and really knew the history of all the areas we visited. We had stops at other homes that Gaudi designed. The highlight for me was seeing the Olympic facilities from the 1992 Olympics. We saw the track, swimming pool and diving pool, the stadium and other areas. We also stopped to grab a bite to eat. The location overlooked all of Barcelona.

title: Excellent bike tour in Barcelona
text: We spent 4 hours exploring Barcelona by bike with Ale today and absolutely loved it. The pace was perfect for our family of 5 and Ale took some fantastic family photos for us along the way too. The kids really enjoyed exploring the City in this way. Would highly recommend!
